what: #150 D-109(c): who holds each production recovery key, by role only (no person's details here), and when each custodian proved possession and decryption (key-possession-check.yml, the answer's SHA-256 matching). Until R1 and R2 are held by two separate custodians and both have proven it, scripts/recovery/backup.mjs refuses every production backup and scripts/recovery/escrow.mjs every escrow and mint. The coordinator records a proof here only after the custodian's answer matched; possession_proven is { "at": "YYYY-MM-DD", "run": "<the possession check's run URL>" }.
